reserveReview.rationale: Tempo identifies pathUSD as issued by Bridge and backed one-for-one by USD-denominated reserves. The October 9, 2026 public API payload at 10:20:33Z reports cash of $19,161,280.75 and treasury of $52,096,485.21, totaling $71,257,765.96, versus reported total reserves of $71,257,752.29: a $13.67 discrepancy. Generic reserve-management documentation lists traditional and tokenized treasury partners but does not identify the instruments within pathUSD's treasury category or their shares. No composition weights are normalized over either conflicting denominator, no treasury-class or tracked-token allocation is assumed, and no liquidity bound is joined to unidentified reserve exposures. The existing composition and composition date remain unchanged; the current researched classification is supplied separately in the campaign fragment.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Correction researched 2026-10-20; original review start retained. The issuer FAQ asserts segregated bankruptcy-remote accounts and names BlackRock and Fidelity, while the reserve-management page describes a generic partner menu rather than pathUSD-specific holdings. No current exact provider allocation or enforceable pathUSD insolvency-priority instrument was retrieved. Binding Stablecoin Terms section 2 requires segregation subject to applicable requirements but expressly denies holders a direct or indirect property interest in, or right to withdraw, reserve assets. Segregation remains an issuer contractual assertion; bankruptcy remoteness, provider identity across the full book and rehypothecation restrictions remain unestablished.
